"'''The Rainy Day Beast / Upgraded'''" is the eighteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[March 19]], [[2025]].
